_comment: ZincAI runtime config. Every value can be overridden by environment variables (env wins): MC_HOST, MC_PORT, MC_USERNAME, MC_VERSION, MC_AUTH, MC_CAN_DIG, AMD_API_BASE_URL, AMD_MODEL, AMD_API_KEY (or API_KEY), ZINC_DATA_DIR, LOG_LEVEL. Credentials: leave amd.apiKey EMPTY and pass AMD_API_KEY/API_KEY via the process environment (Pufferpanel 'secret variables'), or fill amd.apiKey here if the repo stays private. Never commit a real key to a public repo.

server._note: version '' = auto-detect (recommended for 26.3). auth 'offline' for whitelist name-join; 'microsoft' needs a real account and interactive device-code login.

amd._modelNote: Radeon Cloud Token Factory alias for the Qwen 3.8 27B free standing model. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 also works.
